correctness.rationale: A perfect matching must have critical vector \((1,1,1)\). Its five vertex-edge pairs form a rooted primal spanning tree and its nine edge-triangle pairs form a rooted dual spanning tree disjoint from the primal tree; conversely every rooted tree-cotree decomposition gives such an acyclic matching. Exhaustive Prüfer enumeration over all 1296 primal spanning trees gives complementary dual cycle histogram \(5:726,\ 6:540,\ 9:30\), hence \(7{,}140\) tree-cotree decompositions and \(428{,}400\) rooted fields. The embedded verifier replays these counts and the uniform \(28{,}560\)-per-critical-edge tally.

value.rationale: The six-vertex projective plane is the canonical minimal torsion surface triangulation and an explicit benchmark in discrete Morse literature. Counting its entire optimal gradient-field state space, with a structural tree-cotree bijection and refined cycle distribution, is a natural computational-topology invariant useful for testing random and optimization procedures; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
